rationale: A bakery extends the premises it leases. Documents, plans, work value and district parameters are in order, but the lessee files only the lease: the request does not say whether the owner authorises the works, which 2.1.9.5(b) asks of a lessee. Standing is neither shown nor ruled out, so the score sits near the cutoff, set by the standing Criterion. A Cure Request for the owner's authorisation is the natural Determination.
